question: What are two requirements when planning a Cisco HyperFlex All Flash standard cluster installation using three Cisco HX240c M5 Series servers? (Choose two.)
options: If the Jumbo MTU option in the HyperFlex installer is enabled, then jumbo frames do not have to be enabled on the upstream switches.
This cluster deployment type must support a mix of HDD and SSD.
The servers must be discovered, unassociated, and connected to each fabric interconnect.
If the Jumbo MTU option in the HyperFlex installer is enabled, then jumbo frames must also be enabled on the upstream switches.
The hypervisors must be installed to Cisco FlexFlash SD cards.
